skill.name: grammar-style-enhancer
skill.description: Analyzes grammar, clarity, style, consistency, and readability in prose, then recommends voice-preserving edits for fiction, academic, and professional writing.
skill.summary: Reviews prose for grammar, clarity, style, consistency, and readability while preserving the author's voice.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

content.value_statement: Writers often need clear edits without losing their voice. This skill reviews grammar, clarity, style, consistency, and readability, then suggests focused improvements.
actual_capabilities: Identifies grammar, punctuation, spelling, and mechanics issues in prose.
Reviews clarity, concision, ambiguous phrasing, and sentence structure.
Suggests style improvements with specific before-and-after examples.
Checks tense, point of view, spelling variants, and formatting consistency.
Estimates readability signals and organizes issues by revision priority.
Adapts feedback for fiction, academic, non-fiction, and professional drafts.
limitations: Requires user-provided text and context before it can give useful feedback.
Does not independently verify facts, statistics, sources, or citations.
Long manuscripts work best when reviewed in smaller sections.
Suggestions are editorial guidance and may need author judgment.

use_cases.title: Polish Fiction Drafts
use_cases.description: Review scenes for grammar, weak verbs, pacing, and voice-preserving revisions before sharing with readers.

use_cases.title: Prepare Academic Prose
use_cases.description: Improve formal tone, citation-aware phrasing, clarity, and structure in papers or dissertation sections.

use_cases.title: Improve Business Communication
use_cases.description: Make reports, emails, and proposals clearer, more concise, and consistent with a preferred tone.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Grammar
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the text below for grammar, punctuation, and spelling. Explain each correction in simple terms and preserve my voice: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Improve Clarity and Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this passage for wordiness, unclear references, sentence rhythm, and transitions. Suggest prioritized edits and include a revised version: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Match a Style Goal
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this draft for a formal, casual, literary, or academic style while preserving the core message. List changes by grammar, clarity, and voice: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Chapter Excerpt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured grammar and style enhancement report for this excerpt. Include strengths, risks, consistency issues, readability notes, and next revision steps: [paste text]

output_examples.input: She was walking very quickly down the hallway and she was scared.
output_examples.output: Flags weak verbs and repeated intensifiers, then suggests a tighter revision such as: She hurried down the hallway, fear tightening her breath.

output_examples.input: The report was completed by the team. The report was very long. The report was difficult to read.
output_examples.output: Identifies passive voice, repeated sentence starts, and wordiness. Suggests an active, varied version with clearer flow.

output_examples.input: Many researchers think this topic is a really big problem.
output_examples.output: Recommends a more formal academic tone, more precise nouns, stronger verbs, and citation support for the claim.

best_practices: Provide genre, audience, tone, and the exact text section to review.
Review shorter passages first, then apply patterns across the larger draft.
Accept changes that improve clarity while preserving the intended voice.
anti_patterns: Submitting a full manuscript without priorities, context, or target audience.
Treating every style suggestion as mandatory instead of editorial guidance.
Using the skill to verify facts or citations without source material.

faq.question: Can this skill rewrite my text?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest revised passages and explain why each change improves clarity, grammar, or style.

faq.question: Will it preserve my writing voice?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks for voice preferences and marks changes that may affect tone or style.

faq.question: Can it help with academic writing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve formal tone, structure, precision, and citation-aware phrasing when you provide context.

faq.question: Does it verify sources or facts?
faq.answer: No. It can flag unsupported claims, but it does not independently validate facts, statistics, or citations.

faq.question: How much text should I provide?
faq.answer: Use focused sections when possible. Chapters and long drafts are easier to improve in separate passes.

faq.question: Does it require external tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructions analyze user-provided text in context and do not require command execution.
